title: Synthetic Data Analytics Project
summary: A personal ETL/BI learning project that generates simulated social and government-service datasets and pipes them through Airflow, ClickHouse and Superset for dashboarding practice. Its generator scripts call SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and CTGANSynthesizer directly to fit metadata-driven models and sample thousands of synthetic records.
evidence: generator/final_generator.py:33-41 fits GaussianCopulaSynthesizer(metadata) then model.sample(10000); advanced_generator.py:79-85 fits CTGANSynthesizer(metadata, epochs=200)
